item.tib: stag la kho na nying khu'i rgyud las byang phyogs khyung gi sgrub pa
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyis/ phung bon la rgyud (brgyud) cing*/ dar nub res shig byung yang / ma 'ongs dus su/ dbra rigs kho 'o (bo) g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal bdag gis/ me rta zla 6 tshes 1 la gyim shod gnas kyi nub phyogs mdun zhol du bgyis pa'o//
